agy_calls.rationale: Preserve injected decisions stamped for the current tick and skip those factions' recompute, so the injected intent reaches resolution unchanged.
TELEGRAPH-mode attack injections now append a pending telegraph maturing at tick + 3, matching normally-declared telegraphs, while SURPRISE/COLONIZE/REINFORCE paths are unchanged.
